create_gpt2config_default: create a GPT2Config instance with default model parameters
create_gpt2config_custom: create a GPT2Config instance with custom n_layer, n_embd, and n_head values
create_gpt2config_from_checkpoint: create a GPT2Config instance loaded from openai-community/gpt2 checkpoint
review_gpt2config_attributes: review the GPT2Config class attributes including vocab_size, n_positions, n_embd, and n_layer
review_gpt2config_attribute_map: review the GPT2Config attribute_map that maps hidden_size, max_position_embeddings, num_attention_heads, and num_hidden_layers
